description: Source code for an abstract class 'BaseOpenAiCompatibleProvider' implementing a provider for OpenAI-compatible models, including methods for creating streams, handling messages, and managing API interactions.

classes.name: BaseOpenAiCompatibleProvider
classes.description: An abstract class providing a base implementation for OpenAI-compatible providers, managing API calls, streaming, and message handling.

methods.name: createStream
methods.description: Creates a streaming request to the OpenAI API with specified parameters, handling reasoning and tool calls.

methods.name: createMessage
methods.description: Asynchronously creates a message stream, processes chunks, and yields reasoning, text, and tool call events.

methods.name: processUsageMetrics
methods.description: Processes API usage data to compute token counts and cost.

methods.name: completePrompt
methods.description: Completes a prompt using the OpenAI chat API and returns the generated text.

methods.name: getModel
methods.description: Retrieves the current model ID and info based on options and defaults.
